title: house-rules configuration
description: Configuration for the house-rules plugin, stored in .house-rules.json at the repository root. Put every rule under the "rules" object; rule ids at the top level are rejected. A rule value is a severity string, [severity], or [severity, options].

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion and validation. Has no effect on rule behaviour.

rules.description: Map of rule id to rule setting. Rules you omit keep their defaults. Known rules: commit-message, comment-density, artifact-structure, type-escape-hatches, no-module-mocking, code-smells, effect, require-safety-comment-for-type-assertion, require-readable-spacing, silent-early-return-in-test. The id stray-artifacts is a deprecated alias for artifact-structure.

commit-message.description: Checks commit messages against a style preset. Severity can only be "error": a commit that violates the preset is rejected. Use options to choose the preset; the default preset is handbook.

oneOf.description: Severity. "error" rejects a commit whose message violates the preset. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. "error" rejects a commit whose message violates the preset. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for commit-message. Only "preset" is supported.

preset.description: Commit style to enforce. "handbook": subject starts with an imperative verb and is at most 50 characters; no commit body is allowed. "conventional": subject follows type(scope): description with a known type (feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert), at most 72 characters. "subject-only": use when the repository already has its own subject convention (for example commitlint); the subject format is not checked and only the message structure is.

comment-density.description: Limits how many comment lines a change adds relative to the code lines it adds. The cap is fixed at 5 comment lines per 100 added lines. Severity can only be "error". Use it to keep code free of narrating or redundant comments.

oneOf.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that adds too many comment lines. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that adds too many comment lines. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for comment-density. This rule has no options; the object must be empty.

artifact-structure.description: Flags stray files a change leaves behind: coexisting synonym directory pairs (doc and docs, test and tests, script and scripts, util and utils, lib and libs) and root scratch files (test-*.js, *.bak, tmp*, scratch*). Severity can only be "error". Options hold a doc-type manifest (govern, types, forbidden); with no types the rule keeps the legacy stray-file check.

oneOf.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that leaves stray artifacts. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that leaves stray artifacts. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for artifact-structure: the doc-type manifest. All keys are optional; with no types the rule keeps the legacy stray-file check.

govern.description: Glob patterns for the paths the doc-type manifest governs.

types.description: Doc types keyed by type id. A file whose path matches a type's generates template is a document of that type.

tier.description: Lifecycle tier of documents of this type.

generates.description: Path template for documents of this type, for example docs/research/{name:kebab}.md. Placeholders are {name} or {name:kebab|camel|pascal}.

description.description: What documents of this type are for.

instruction.description: Instruction shown to the author when the type applies.

template.description: Inline starter text for new documents of this type, or null for none.

frontmatter.description: JSON Schema for the document frontmatter. Stored, not validated.

headings.description: Headings documents of this type carry.

headingsWhen.description: Headings required only when a frontmatter property has one of the listed values.

in.description: Values of the property that make the headings required.

headings.description: Headings required when the property matches.

forbidden.description: Path patterns that must not be created, each with the place to put the file instead.

pattern.description: Glob for forbidden paths. ** matches any depth, * one path segment, ? one character.

redirect.description: Where the file belongs instead. May contain {slug}.

stray-artifacts.description: Flags stray files a change leaves behind: coexisting synonym directory pairs (doc and docs, test and tests, script and scripts, util and utils, lib and libs) and root scratch files (test-*.js, *.bak, tmp*, scratch*). Severity can only be "error". Options hold a doc-type manifest (govern, types, forbidden); with no types the rule keeps the legacy stray-file check.

oneOf.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that leaves stray artifacts. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that leaves stray artifacts. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for artifact-structure: the doc-type manifest. All keys are optional; with no types the rule keeps the legacy stray-file check.

types.description: Doc types keyed by type id. A file whose path matches a type's generates template is a document of that type.

tier.description: Lifecycle tier of documents of this type.

generates.description: Path template for documents of this type, for example docs/research/{name:kebab}.md. Placeholders are {name} or {name:kebab|camel|pascal}.

instruction.description: Instruction shown to the author when the type applies.

template.description: Inline starter text for new documents of this type, or null for none.

frontmatter.description: JSON Schema for the document frontmatter. Stored, not validated.

in.description: Values of the property that make the headings required.

type-escape-hatches.description: Flags TypeScript patterns that bypass the type checker. It runs 9 checks: no-chained-type-assertions, no-known-value-widening, no-object-parameters, no-runtime-typeof, no-unknown-parameters, no-unknown-returns, no-unknown-type-aliases, no-unsafe-dictionary-type, and no-widen-then-assert. Severity can be "warn" or "off". The only option is allowInTypeGuards.

oneOf.description: Severity. The default is "warn": the rule flags a type escape hatch without rejecting the change. "off" disables the rule. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. The default is "warn": the rule flags a type escape hatch without rejecting the change. "off" disables the rule. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for type-escape-hatches. The only option is allowInTypeGuards.

allowInTypeGuards.description: When true, no-runtime-typeof does not flag typeof inside a user-defined type guard (a function that returns x is T). The default is false.

no-module-mocking.description: Flags module-level mocks in tests. Severity can be "warn" or "off"; the rule has no options.

oneOf.description: Severity. The default is "warn": the rule flags a module-level mock without rejecting the change. "off" disables the rule. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. The default is "warn": the rule flags a module-level mock without rejecting the change. "off" disables the rule. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for no-module-mocking. This rule has no options; the object must be empty.

code-smells.description: Flags assorted low-signal code smells in added code. Severity can be "warn" or "off"; the rule has no options.

oneOf.description: Severity. The default is "warn": the rule flags a code smell without rejecting the change. "off" disables the rule. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. The default is "warn": the rule flags a code smell without rejecting the change. "off" disables the rule. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for code-smells. This rule has no options; the object must be empty.

effect.description: Opt-in group of five Effect checks for TypeScript and JavaScript: prefer-effect-match, no-manual-effect-error-tag, no-service-constructor-imports (skips test and spec files), no-manual-tag-comparison, and no-manual-tagged-construction. Off by default. Severity can be "warn" or "off"; the rule has no options.

oneOf.description: Severity. The default is "off": the Effect checks are opt-in. "warn" enables them without rejecting the change. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. The default is "off": the Effect checks are opt-in. "warn" enables them without rejecting the change. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for effect. This rule has no options; the object must be empty.

require-safety-comment-for-type-assertio.description: Flags non-const type assertions (as and <T> casts) in TypeScript that have no SAFETY: comment right before the assertion or its statement. as const is exempt. The default severity is "off"; "warn" opts in. Severity can be "warn" or "off"; the rule has no options.

oneOf.description: Severity. The default is "off": the rule does nothing until you set "warn", which flags an unjustified type assertion without rejecting the change. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. The default is "off": the rule does nothing until you set "warn", which flags an unjustified type assertion without rejecting the change. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for require-safety-comment-for-type-assertion. This rule has no options; the object must be empty.

require-readable-spacing.description: Flags statements in TypeScript and JavaScript that need a blank line before them, following the padding-line-between-statements policy of ESLint Stylistic. It never autofixes. The default severity is "off"; "warn" opts in. Severity can be "warn" or "off"; the rule has no options.

oneOf.description: Severity. The default is "off": the rule does nothing until you set "warn", which flags cramped code without rejecting the change. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. The default is "off": the rule does nothing until you set "warn", which flags cramped code without rejecting the change. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for require-readable-spacing. This rule has no options; the object must be empty.

silent-early-return-in-test.description: Flags tests that skip their assertions through an early return, such as if (!cond) return; in a test body, so the test passes without checking anything. The default severity is "warn". Severity can be "warn" or "off"; the rule has no options.

oneOf.description: Severity. The default is "warn": the rule flags a test that returns early without rejecting the change. "off" disables the rule. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. The default is "warn": the rule flags a test that returns early without rejecting the change. "off" disables the rule. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for silent-early-return-in-test. This rule has no options; the object must be empty.
